_comment: One plain sentence per call on who can apply, taken from the call's own text on the Funding & Tenders Portal (description or conditions). Add a 'scheme' only when that text states it. For most Creative Europe and CERV calls the portal says the rules are 'described in the call document' (a PDF); those calls have no entry here and the page says 'Check eligibility on the portal'.

CREA-CULT-2027-LIT.who_can_apply: A single organisation or a consortium of organisations can apply.
CREA-CULT-2027-LIT.source: Topic description: 'implemented either by a single entity (mono-beneficiary) or by a consortium of organisations (multi-beneficiary)'

ERASMUS-EDU-2027-EUR-UNIV.who_can_apply: Alliances of higher education institutions that already cooperate closely across countries.
ERASMUS-EDU-2027-EUR-UNIV.source: Topic description: 'will support alliances of higher education institutions demonstrating an existing deep institutional transnational cooperation'

ERASMUS-EDU-2026-EUED.who_can_apply: Higher education institutions designing transnational joint programmes at bachelor, master or doctoral level.
ERASMUS-EDU-2026-EUED.source: Topic description: 'supporting higher education institutions in the design, adaptation, and implementation of innovative and inclusive transnational joint programmes at bachelor, master, or doctoral levels'

CREA-CROSS-2027-JOURPART-PLURALISM.who_can_apply: Organisations able to run funding schemes (re-granting) for news media and independent journalism.
CREA-CROSS-2027-JOURPART-PLURALISM.source: Topic description: 'Applicant organisations should be in a position to set up funding schemes (support to third parties) targeting news media outlets'
